source: work.task_event (content-free) + work.member seats; computed per org_id, never per user in dashboards

activation.definition: org is activated when >=3 distinct seated members submit >=1 task within 14 days of the org flag turning on
activation.numerator: distinct subjects with task.submitted within 14d of enablement

technical_success_rate.definition: run.succeeded / (run.succeeded + run.failed); user-canceled runs are excluded

acceptance_rate.definition: tasks with task.completed basis=version / tasks that reached task.awaiting_acceptance

reason_completion_share.definition: task.completed basis=reason / all task.completed; high values mean outputs are not used

time_to_first_artifact_p50_seconds.definition: median of first artifact.published minus task.submitted per task

golden_suite_pass_ratio.definition: golden tasks meeting pass_rule / all golden tasks (golden-tasks.json)
